limitations: Empty hardware map, never call hardware init/connect; connected and installed-but-disconnected cores unmeasured.
Extension domain/block registration uses the real official registration APIs, but hardware init is intentionally omitted. This is not a default installed editor profile.
Native observations cover the generated default/number-one fixture, one sibling-reporter sum and one synchronous control; not all nesting/warp/stop/restart schedules.
Finite native event silence does not prove global unreachability; manual send_action and synthetic notifications remain outside the profile.

Default microphone is pending at 3000ms before consent; later real modal denial and browser NotAllowedError are distinguished. Actual NotFoundError/no-device, successful capture and other platforms unmeasured. recordEnable=false is selected explicitly.
Generic tools/editor-compat.mjs does not load these lazy hardware extensions; nativeSetup.editorCompat runs extension-aware validateBcm and all-block field/connection checks before playing.
Downloaded official implementation and full module bodies exist only under ignored dist; evidence JSON retains only observations, metadata and source hashes.
